definitions.explanation: A state of being unoccupied, unused, or available. Refers to vacant rooms, empty seats, free time slots, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{空|あ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I was in trouble because there were no spaces in the parking lot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{火曜日|かようび}→火曜日：00640_kayoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{空|あ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れましょう→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: There's an opening next Tuesday, so let's book an appointment for that day.

notes:
The noun form of the verb ⟦{空|あ}く→空く：11062_aku⟧ (to become empty/vacant). Refers to something being unoccupied, unused, or available.

COMPOUNDS:
- {空|あ}き{部屋|べや}: vacant room
- {空|あ}き{地|ち}: vacant lot
- {空|あ}き{缶|かん}: empty can
- {空|あ}き{瓶|びん}: empty bottle
- {空|あ}き{時間|じかん}: free time, spare time
- {空|あ}き{巣|す}: burglary of an empty house

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {空|あ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there is an opening/vacancy
- {空|あ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: no vacancy, fully booked
- {空|あ}き⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧: availability status

USAGE:
Very common in reservation contexts — hotels, parking, restaurants, and appointment scheduling all use {空|あ}き to indicate availability.
